reviews.author: Anthony Fain
reviews.text: Delicious food and great service — always a nice experience whether we go for lunch or dinner. Never had to ask for a refill or a box because they were already on it. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Jada Green
reviews.text: Today was my first time eating here and it was 10/10 — everything was so good. Service was great, the food was hot and fresh. I don't know why I hadn't eaten here sooner. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Becky Ryan
reviews.text: Have enjoyed this place for a long time! Good food, good people — can't beat it!
